experiment: dual co-residency: qwen3.8-27B (luce_server, R9700) + qwen3.8-flash-next IQ3_S (Strata, R9700)
host: borg (Strix Halo 395 + Radeon AI PRO R9700 32GB, gfx1201)

methodology.decode_probe: gen_probe.py, random ~7.3k-token prompt (words=2000), max_tokens=512, temp 0, 3 rounds
methodology.caveat: decode tps is server-reported; greedy temp-0 runs terminate early on EOS (~74 tokens for qwen), so qwen decode figures reflect short steady-state windows. Flashnext 512-token runs are full-length.

scenarios.notes: decode rounds [68.6, 61.4, 60.5]; 2.5k prefill rounds [873.7, 1122.5]; 7.3k prefill 1021-1110 t/s; VRAM 25.4/32GB

HARD FAILURE. Boots to session-up but expert-cache auto computed 0.10 GiB free with qwen resident -> 0 expert slots (needs >=302, ~1184 MiB short). Server then dies at first prompt: 'device buffers for a chunk of 512 tokens do not fit' / 'GPU has too little free VRAM for the prompt path'. Exact OOM captured in results/dualqfn-fn-solo.log
qwen stayed healthy co-resident (27.8/32 GB) but flashnext never became serviceable; concurrency scenario impossible without shrinking qwen KV/context or flashnext cache
NOT RUN - co-residency failed at boot+first-prompt; no contention numbers possible in this config

decode rounds (tps,ntok) [(59.5, 512), (37.9, 294), (34.4, 512)] token-weighted 44.9 t/s; 2.5k prefill [487.2, 481.7]; 7.3k prefill avg 1149.7; wall-decode r1 ~75 t/s over 512 tok; expert-cache full (33.7/34.2GB), 98.7% hit rate

memory.dual_attempt: GPU0 27.8/32 GB at flashnext session-up; strata 0 expert slots
memory.flashnext_solo: GPU0 33.7-33.9/34.2 GB VRAM; system RAM 78-79/124 GB used

summary.verdict: CO-RESIDENCY NOT VIABLE in current configs. flashnext IQ3_S with expert-cache auto cannot co-reside with qwen 27B on one R9700: qwen's 25.4 GB leaves ~8.8 GB, but flashnext needs ~31.4 GB (46.8 GiB expert set + KV + head). Boot reaches session-up with 0 expert slots, then hard-fails on the first prompt (prefill buffers don't fit). Not an OOM crash of qwen; it is a deterministic flashnext capacity failure with exact logged error.
options: run flashnext on the iGPU (run-iq3_s-gfx1151.sh) with qwen on R9700
cut flashnext --max-context / kv q4_0 / en-draft to shrink footprint
shrink qwen --max-ctx to free VRAM (would still leave flashnext ~7 GB short)
summary.production_recommendation: Split across devices (qwen hip:0 + flashnext hip:1 iGPU) instead of sharing hip:0; the prior dual-device result (2-9% mutual cost) remains the viable path.
